title: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max launches with three 200MP rear cameras, Dimensity 9600 Pro SoC
description: Oppo has just unveiled its latest flagship smartphone, the Find X10 Pro Max. This is powered by the new MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset, just like the vivo X500 Pro Max which was unveiled yesterday. The Oppo Find X10 Pro Max one-ups its direct competitor in terms of cameras, though, sporting a whopping three 200MP sensors on the rear. title: Here's when the vivo X500 series is launching in Europe
description: vivo launched the X500, X500 Pro, and X500 Pro Max in China yesterday, and today the company has already revealed when they're coming to Europe. The European launch event will take place on October 27, which is also when pre-orders will start. The devices will then be released on November 5. There is, however, something you need to know - while vivo's page talks about the "X500 series", the vanilla X500 is not shown. title: OnePlus N6 Lite goes official with a 7,000mAh battery
description: OnePlus has expanded its N6 lineup in India with the launch of the new OnePlus N6 Lite. The affordable 4G smartphone packs a 7,000mAh battery and joins the OnePlus N6 and N6x in the country. The OnePlus N6 Lite is priced at INR 16,999 for the sole 4GB RAM and 64GB storage variant. It is available in Midnight Black and a bright Neo Green colorway. It is powered by the Unisoc T7250 chipset and comes with a 6.75-inch LCD display that offers a 120Hz refresh rate and 900 nits in high-brightness mode. Huang Tao, Vice President of Product at vivo, reportedly confirmed that the vivo X500 Ultra will debut in China sometime in March or April 2027. description: Oppo launched the A7 Pro Max in China in August, and now the phone has finally made its way to other markets, including Austria in Europe. title: Apple Pay reportedly set to launch in India next month
description: According to a new report, Apple could launch its Apple Pay payment service in India as soon as next month. The service is currently available in more than 90 countries worldwide. In his latest Power On newsletter, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman claims that Apple will launch Apple Pay in India by the end of October. While Gurman did not provide any further details about the service, a recent Reuters report claimed that Apple will initially roll out Apple Pay in partnership with Axis Bank credit cards.
